lessons.key: ac_gap::deleting a parent entity must also clean up its dependent external resources e g storage files not just rely on db cascade delete for child rows
lessons.text: Deleting a parent entity must also clean up its dependent external resources (e.g., storage files), not just rely on DB cascade-delete for child rows.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::assert security sensitive response headers e g set cookie httponly samesite flags by parsing the actual raw header value not via a convenience client that discards attributes
lessons.text: Assert security-sensitive response headers (e.g., Set-Cookie HttpOnly/SameSite flags) by parsing the actual raw header value, not via a convenience client that discards attributes.
